a.text: Fear. It's a tolerance that we are naturally born with, just like how plants are able to adapt to soil that make havoc of their own rootstocks.
To shatter our will, they'll need to spread a much great 'dosage' of fear in Brentwood.
Freda is the greatest testament.
She is so fragile that you could break her simply by bumping into her, but she persisted among that crowd of terrifying men up till now.
But I can tell that she needs someone to confide in and vent her fear.
Will... he's not mature enough. It's not very likely he would understand how Freda feels.
Perhaps I can help her?

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: You didn't bring my order to my tent... Magdelene.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: And you didn't leave Brentwood either. A pitiful decision.

a.text: He seems very feeble, even more so than yesterday.
What happened?

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: Why didn't you leave?

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: This is my home.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Do you have a new order for me? I can bring it to you along with the flowers last night.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: ...You don't have to worry about those orders anymore.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: I'm here to say goodbye.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: I'm leaving soon... to fight as part of the Nachzehrer King's army...

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Goodbye, if that's what you wanted to hear from me.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: You're too naive... to the point of foolishness.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: Everything that I've tried to protect, always courts its own destruction.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: Perhaps I've been wrong from the start.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: I don't understand what you're saying, Shovel.

spans.text: I don't understand what you're saying,

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: I used to be incredibly jealous of all of you.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: Victoria used to be the noblest and strongest nation there was. Naturally, you possessed many great things, and rightfully so.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: With the metallurgy you originated and the Steam Knights, you conquered another empire. With your mystifying art and rich academia, you attracted all of Terra's geniuses...

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: Yet now, you've halted your outward conquest. Now, your rulers only indulge in parties and wine, only ever boasting about the medals on their chest.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: They crush their own glory, and they are destined to be replaced—

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: Hm? You still have this wall clock...

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: Time really flies. The town's citizens must all have gone to the work site.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: Your deaths are unavoidable, Magdelene.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: The Sanguinarch is an impatient man.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: That's why the ritual was pushed forward, and under that Feline's leadership, the mission was indeed completed most marvelously.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: Everyone here will be the key to the ritual's activation.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: Of course, that includes you.

a.text: Ritual... Key...

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: He was stopped by the devils at the Sarkaz barracks just now.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Freda... Do you see that?

a.text: The blood-colored worm is staring at me.
<color=#cc0000>'The entire town will be the key to the ritual's activation.'</color>
The key...
My soul is trembling.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: I need to go find Freda!

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Let me go!

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: You mustn't leave this greenhouse.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: Wait a little longer, Magdelene. I'll be here with you.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: Until we bid each other farewell for the last time.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Why... The people of the town have never done anything against your wishes!

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Freda and everyone fulfilled each and every one of your requests!

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: His Highness decided to carry out this war, and your dukes responded. This outcome has nothing to do with us or you.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: All we need to do is follow our orders.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Then let me warn the people at the work site! Just pretend you don't know anything like before, please!

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: I serve His Highness, and I won't allow you to quash this ritual...

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: Not unless you make it past me, Magdelene.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: Can you do it, Gardener?

a.text: He grabs me by the hand, but places it on a pair of scissors in his hand.
There seems to be a ray of longing burning in the depths of his ashen eyes.
What is this prideful man longing for?
Release? Pity? Or is it perhaps... that word that I can't bring myself to touch?
I notice that even though the two of us have spent a very long time together in this greenhouse, I've never actually truly understood this man.
But I have to leave now. Just as he said, there is no time.
I'm sorry.
I can't stand by and watch anymore—

steps.name: Skeptical Citizen
steps.text: Magdelene, where are you going? Why the rush?

steps.name: Skeptical Citizen
steps.text: Is that... blood on your clothes...? Are you okay?

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: It's fine—I cut my finger while I was pruning branches...

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Henk, where's Freda?

steps.name: Skeptical Citizen
steps.text: Freda? After she came back from the barracks by herself this morning, she went straight to the Sarkaz officers.

steps.name: Skeptical Citizen
steps.text: She seemed rather out of it, and she kept saying sorry no matter who she ran into.

steps.name: Skeptical Citizen
steps.text: Did something happen?

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Everyone has to leave this place right now.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: And the farther, the better!

steps.name: Skeptical Citizen
steps.text: What's with all of you being so bloody barmy today?

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: There's no time to explain. I need to tell everyone else!

steps.name: Skeptical Citizen
steps.text: But we're almost finished! Besides, if we all ditch work, what are we supposed to do when those officers find us?

steps.name: Skeptical Citizen
steps.text: Fireworks? Where?

steps.name: Skeptical Citizen
steps.text: Who blew that wall open? Is that... Freda?

a.text: The last time I saw such beautiful fireworks. It was the harvest festival when I was ten.
Grandfather put me on his shoulders and walked through the crowd.
Everyone looked up to the fireworks blooming in the sky astonished. Everyone kept quiet, only for the silence to be torn apart by the explosive sound wave a moment later.
This is just like that.
Freda set off the cannon Mr. West was hiding for the harvest festival. There are countless Sarkaz pulling her from behind.
Drenched in blood, she is shouting something, but whatever she is trying to say, it's buried by the cannon's loud roar.
She is buried by the wave of Sarkaz gushing toward her and torn apart.
A flame burning bright in the middle of the day—
The cannons keep roaring.
A grand ceremony has come to Brentwood ahead of schedule.

steps.name: Frightened Civilian
steps.text: What just happened? Is there an earthquake?

steps.name: Frightened Woman
steps.text: R-Run!

steps.name: Frightened Civilian
steps.text: You're bleeding... Bollocks... Stay away! Those disgusting monsters are dripping from your body!

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: What are the Sarkaz trying to do?

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Henk, Henk! You can't close your eyes...

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: I... I'm starting to feel very tired too... So sleepy...

a.text: I can feel my own blood fluttering out of my body.
Before disappearing into the earth.

steps.text: Magdelene! Hang in there!
Captain, I got her!
Everyone, hold onto the ropes as tight as you can. Do not touch the ground, no matter what!
Hurry and help them!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Magdelene, you can't fall asleep!

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Rockrock?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: This guy's so heavy!

steps.name: Unconscious Civilian
steps.text: Mmm...

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Feist... The Self-Salvation Corps... Why are you...?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We figured something went wrong when we saw fireworks in the middle of the day! They sealed the wall we blew open yesterday, but that cannon gave us a new path.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Hold onto Rockrock's hand, Magdelene! Our forces don't have enough manpower, and we're bringing everyone to evacuate as soon as we can!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Woahh! Feist, your zipline's even faster after those modifications you made!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Right, where is Mayor Freda? We haven't been able to locate her.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: ...Freda is—

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Drat, why did my zipline start shaking?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: What about that weak garrison commander? Where is he hiding this time?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Well, no matter... I'll take over command.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I can feel it. My blood... is boiling.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: No need to contact Major Ulšulah's squad. We can take care of these laughable Victorians by ourselves.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Kill them all.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: The garrison here is mounting a counter-attack. They're putting more pressure on us than any Sarkaz we've faced before!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: How much explosive does Old Weiss still have outside? Can he make it here in time to back us up?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Probably not happening. Not counting the members who laid the ziplines for us, we barely had any fighting men to begin with.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Start the Crawlers! We need to break through by force!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Rockrock, watch out! Your zipline!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Ah—

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: That hurts—

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Magdelene, are you okay?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Can you walk? Gah, these disgusting things—

a.text: On the sundering earth, a large number of red worms keep gushing onto surface. They chew on every soul they can reach and suck their blood.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: This is the Prince's blessing. It's the kindness the Royal Court left for us.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: In our bodies... our purest blood is now awakening. Let's waste no more time on these Victorians!

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Rockrock, you should go—

a.text: The Feline girl named Rockrock takes out a dagger from her waist and stuffs it into my hand.
A large group of Sarkaz are closing in on our location.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Magdelene, get ready to fight.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: It's not that hard. None of us... had any combat experience before.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Take a deep breath and make up your mind.

a.text: Make up my mind.
Right.
Just like... that Sarkaz officer who collapsed among the fluttering petals.
I grip the dagger tight.
A shot rings out.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Artillery fire? I thought we used up all our explosives!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Quick, Rockrock, Magdelene, now!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We were contacted by a few old friends. They brought a whole backup unit! They even have an identification code—

a.text: Identification code?
Is it the military? Victorian... Right... the military is responding to the war.
They must be a group of ice-cold men. They're here to kill the Sarkaz and save the Victorians. They—

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: 'The Exemplars!'

a.text: A thick, roiling cloud of dust is kicked up into the air all over within view. Again and again, bright flashes of light suddenly erupts across the ground.
What is that... A tank?
I can hear a firm, persevering female voice coming from Feist's communicator.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: This is Tank Fire Team Horn. All units, make sure to stay clear of my blast zone.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Grenade loaded. Firing second barrage!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Opening created. Cover the Self-Salvation Corps and all citizens!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Horn, continue laying suppressive fire.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Those Arts Circles... We need to find a way to stop this bloody witchcraft.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Vina, have someone else drive. I want to join the ground combat!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Hannah, eyes on the road!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Alright, alright!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Get the tank as close to the core of the Arts Circle as possible. I'll take care of that thing!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Vina!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You have other tasks.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: All units, follow regular deployment formation. Morgan, Hannah, follow Horn's orders and cut open a path for the tank.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Lieutenant Shearer, Dagda, Delphine, take command of the ground forces and form a defensive line. Stop the Sanguinarch's worms.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I'm on it.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: Acknowledged.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Acknowledged.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Mr. Misery, I'll leave the commander of the enemy forces to you.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: All you need to do is boldly execute your plan.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Feist, it's been a while. We shall exchange pleasantries later. I need the Self-Salvation Corps to help set up a zipline that will take me above the Arts Circle.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: On it!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We have no time to lose. Let us take care of the strange Arts Circle first.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I will leave my rear to all of you.

a.text: While I was still trying to identify the squad that suddenly came to our aid, the blond Feline has already ziplined to the center of the battlefield.
She descended from the sky, and bombastically made her way into the center of the Arts Circle's blood-red pillar of light. The sound of rocks blasted apart ring throughout the entire battlefield.
'Thump.'
I can see each and every swing of her large sledgehammer in that red light.
'Forward!'
The Feline's voice ignites the tank's engine.
I see a warrior holding a sledgehammer up high leading the Victorians to retake our land.

steps.name: Cheering Civilian
steps.text: Look! Look how easily our Victorian tank fire can blast that thing apart!

steps.name: Cheering Civilian
steps.text: We said as much long ago. Them bloody devils are no match for Victoria's military!

steps.name: Cheering Civilian
steps.text: Crush them!

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: No, there are too many Originium crystals in town...

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: The mayor's office, the small town square, the library... those things we've been rebuilding day in and day out...

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: We won't make it in time—

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Is it over?

a.text: No...
The pillar of red light rises from the building we built and intermingles with the festive fireworks.
There is a blood-red color boiling in that dark abyss.
The similarly red worms are reaching their antennae toward the sky.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The Arts Circle has been damaged. The Vampires' offspring have gone berserk. Seize this opportunity!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Infantry units, stop advancing. Escort all citizens out of the Arts Circle's range.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Tank squad, follow me and push forward. Destroy the remaining Originium crystals in the town and commence search and rescue!

a.text: Hell is invading my town.
All while the formation's rumbling tank accelerates and blitzes in on the devils.
